es.name: Galletas de Malta
es.blurb: La malta de cebada en polvo aporta enzimas y maltosa, que dora con más facilidad que la sacarosa. El resultado sabe al interior de una bolita de leche malteada.
es.lab: Malta en polvo · tostada, nostálgica, algo salada
steps: Tuesta la mantequilla y enfríala 10 minutos.
Bate dentro los dos azúcares, luego el huevo y la yema.
Incorpora la harina, la malta en polvo, el bicarbonato y la sal.
Incorpora los dos chocolates: el de leche es acertado aquí, cosa que no suele ser, porque malta y chocolate con leche son la misma familia de sabor.
Hornea bolas de 55 g a 185 °C durante 12 minutos.
tips: La leche malteada contiene malta de cebada, así que no es sin gluten aunque parezca un lácteo.
La malta diastática es otra cosa y aflojará la masa. Quieres la de beber.
Chocolate con leche y malta, y negro para equilibrar. Solo con leche resulta empalagoso.

en.name: Malted Milk Cookies
en.blurb: Barley malt powder brings enzymes and maltose, which browns more readily than sucrose. The result tastes like the inside of a malted milk ball.
en.lab: Malt powder · toasty, nostalgic, a little salty
steps: Brown the butter and cool it 10 minutes.
Beat in both sugars, then the egg and yolk.
Fold in the flour, malt powder, baking soda and salt.
Fold in both chocolates: milk chocolate is the right call here, which it usually isn't, because malt and milk chocolate are the same flavor family.
Bake 55 g balls at 185 °C for 12 minutes.
tips: Malted milk powder contains barley malt, so it isn't gluten-free even though it looks like a dairy product.
Diastatic malt is something else and will slacken the dough. You want the drinking kind.
Milk chocolate with the malt, and dark to balance it. Milk chocolate alone is cloying.
